description: This file defines the 'HierarchicalKeyStore' class implementing the 'ILocalDataStore' interface. It provides methods for reading, writing, deleting, and dumping key-value data structured in hierarchical layers, with support for multi-layered key management and concurrency control.

classes.name: HierarchicalKeyStore
classes.description: An internal class that manages hierarchical key-value storage with support for multiple key layers, concurrency, and versioning via ETag.

methods.name: WriteRow
methods.description: Stores or updates a row of data identified by a list of keys, generating a new ETag for versioning.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Retrieves a single data row based on a list of keys.

methods.name: ReadMultiRow
methods.description: Retrieves multiple data rows matching a set of keys within the hierarchy.

methods.name: DeleteRow
methods.description: Deletes a data row identified by the list of keys, returning whether the deletion was successful.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all stored data in the data table.

methods.name: DumpData
methods.description: Returns a string representation of all stored data, optionally printing details via Trace.

methods.name: GetDataStore
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create a data store for a given set of keys.

methods.name: FindDataStores
methods.description: Internal method to find all data stores matching a prefix of keys.

methods.name: MakeStoreKey
methods.description: Static method to create a string key from a collection of key pairs, used for data table indexing.

methods.name: NewEtag
methods.description: Generates a new ETag string based on an incrementing counter.
